title: Phrase
description: Serialized form of a Phrase. CANONICAL form omits `raga` (inherited from the piece). On load, (ratios, fundamental) are threaded from the piece raga down through trajectoryGrid; if absent, the phrase's own embedded `raga` (LEGACY) supplies fallback context.

trajectoryGrid.description: String-indexed grid: trajectoryGrid[string][i] = Trajectory. Row 0 = main string.

syllables.description: PROP-8 (contract 0.3.0): the syllable tier of this phrase's main string (trajectoryGrid[0]). ABSENT = not yet healed: the loader builds it from the legacy per-trajectory fields (vowel, startConsonant, endConsonant) by the firstTrajIdxs rule; [] = healed, no syllables. Canonical output always emits it and dual-writes the legacy fields projected from it through 0.3.x. Syllables follow their trajectory: after any phrase split, merge or moved division each syllable is re-homed to the phrase that now holds its anchor trajectory.

raga.description: LEGACY ONLY — stripped in canonical form (inherited from piece). If present, used as fallback context for threading.
